scenes.title: Modern resource loader startup diagnostics
scenes.objective: Record latest.log and active model/resource warnings for both clients.
steps: Confirm Minecraft/loader/Java/mod list and record a fresh startup log; the original baseline is not the port runtime SHA.
Do not classify absence of loader errors as gameplay PASS.
scenes.prerequisites: Clean 1.21.1 NeoForge with current port at exact commit; record mod list, Java, shaders/CTM, resource-pack order, resolution, FOV and gamma; F3+T resource reload.
scenes.note: Steps are based on existing paired-world instructions or source audit; must be confirmed in each game.

scenes.title: Resource reload smoke
scenes.objective: Compare reload warnings and metadata playback after F3+T.
steps: Open each client with identical resource-pack settings; save pre-reload log.
Use F3+T in each client, then record any warnings and save post-reload log.
scenes.prerequisites: Clean 1.21.1 NeoForge with current port at exact commit; record mod list, Java, shaders/CTM, resource-pack order, resolution, FOV and gamma; F3+T resource reload.

scenes.title: Pickup Advanced seal GUI opening
scenes.objective: Check opening, tabs, saved filter/color versus source legacy contract.
steps: Use the paired RESET-world green Seals station after initial fresh-research capture and tc_parity:unlock.
Place Pickup Advanced on a stone top face, hold Golemancer's Bell; use right click without Shift on the same face.
Record GUI tabs, parameters, filters, then close/reopen. Shift+right click removes the seal; do not use for GUI.
